body.en: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pump-delivery-flow-velocity-water-d_232.html electric 50 vs electric 60 concrete pump Electric 50 vs Electric 60 Concrete Pump Both pages list three stone-distance rows. Power, output, pressure and the fine-stone pair are different. Electric 50 and Electric 60 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 50 lists 55 kW, 26 m³/h, 30 MPa and fine-stone 150 m / 350 m. Electric 60 lists 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and fine-stone 200 m / 600 m. Each page also lists its own 13 mm and 24 mm rows. Do not move the 600 m figure onto the Electric 50 page. Where Electric 50 and Electric 60 list different values Motor power: Electric 50 lists 55 kW; Electric 60 lists 90 kW. Theoretical output: Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h; Electric 60 lists 40 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 50 lists 30 MPa; Electric 60 lists 35 MPa. Hopper capacity: Electric 50 lists 0.4 m³; Electric 60 lists 0.7 m³. Fine-stone conveying (H / V): Electric 50 lists 150 m / 350 m; Electric 60 lists 200 m / 600 m. 13 mm stone (H / V): Electric 50 lists 80 m / 240 m; Electric 60 lists 150 m / 450 m. These are listed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Cells that exist on only one of these pumps Both pages use the same set of labels. Where the values differ, keep the value on the page you opened. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. How to read the two pages without merging them Three distance rows on both sheets still leave every number page-specific. Open /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ for Electric 50 and /en/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric 60. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price. Does Electric 50 list the same motor power as Electric 60? No. Electric 50 lists 55 kW. Electric 60 lists 90 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other. Does Electric 50 list the same theoretical output as Electric 60? No. Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h. Electric 60 lists 40 m³/h. Does Electric 50 list the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 60? No. Electric 50 lists 30 MPa. Electric 60 lists 35 MPa. Can I treat Electric 50 and Electric 60 as one concrete pump? No. They are separate pages from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Match power, output, pressure and distance on the page you intend to order. Electric 50 concrete pump, catalogue comparison, Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, Hebei
body.zh:
https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pump-delivery-flow-velocity-water-d_232.html
电动50和电动60混凝土泵的区别
电动50和电动60混凝土泵有何不同
两页都印三行石子距离。
功率、产量、压力和细石那一组数字不同。
电动50和电动60是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。
电动50印 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa、细石 150 m / 350 m。
电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、细石 200 m / 600 m。
两页还有各自的 13 mm 和 24 mm 行。
不要把 600 m 挪到电动50页面上。
电动50和电动60哪些数值不同
电机功率：电动50印 55 kW；电动60印 90 kW。
理论输送量：电动50印 26 m³/h；电动60印 40 m³/h。
最大出口压力：电动50印 30 MPa；电动60印 35 MPa。
料斗容积：电动50印 0.4 m³；电动60印 0.7 m³。
细石输送（水平/垂直）：电动50印 150 m / 350 m；电动60印 200 m / 600 m。
13 mm石子（水平/垂直）：电动50印 80 m / 240 m；电动60印 150 m / 450 m。
以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。
只在其中一台泵上出现的格子
两页标题集合相同。
数值不同时，以你打开的那一页为准。
缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。
怎样分开阅读这两个页面
两边都有三行距离，每个数字仍然只属于自己的页面。
看电动50请打开 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/，看电动60请打开 /zh/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/。
河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。
商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。
如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。
电动50和电动60的电机功率一样吗？
不一样。
电动50印 55 kW。
电动60印 90 kW。
两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。
电动50和电动60的理论输送量一样吗？
电动50印 26 m³/h。
电动60印 40 m³/h。
电动50和电动60的最大出口压力一样吗？
电动50印 30 MPa。
电动60印 35 MPa。
可以把电动50和电动60当成同一台混凝土泵吗？
不能。
它们是河北品锦机械在邢台的两个页面。
要按下单的那一页核对功率、产量、压力和距离。
电动50混凝土泵目录对照，河北品锦机械，河北邢台

question.en: Does Electric 50 list the same motor power as Electric 60?
question.zh: 电动50和电动60的电机功率一样吗？

question.en: Can I treat Electric 50 and Electric 60 as one concrete pump?
question.zh: 可以把电动50和电动60当成同一台混凝土泵吗？

answer.en: No. They are separate pages from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Match power, output, pressure and distance on the page you intend to order.
